item.title: Doctored Video Of Army Chief Opposing Pakistan’s Inclusion In Trump’s ‘Board Of Peace’ Shared As Real
item.description: The viral video claiming that Army Chief General Upendra Dwivedi opposed Pakistan’s inclusion in Trump’s “Board of Peace” is fake and digitally manipulated.

item.title: Danish Parliament Erupts In Laughter Over Donald Trump’s Nobel Prize Demand? Here’s The Truth Behind Viral Video
item.description: The viral post claiming to show Danish parliamentarians laughing over Donald Trump’s demand for a Nobel Peace Prize was found to be false.

item.title: Viral Photo Of PM Modi Watching Border 2 With SRK, Salman Khan & Sunny Deol Is AI-Generated
item.description: The viral image claiming to show PM Modi watching Border 2 with Shah Rukh Khan, Salman Khan, and Sunny Deol in a cinema hall was AI-generated.

item.title: Viral Footage Of Torch Rally Does Not Show Protests Against New UGC Rules
item.description: The viral torch rally video does not show protests against new UGC rules. It is from an older Congress-led protest in Odisha related to the National Herald case involving Sonia Gandhi and Rahul Gandhi.

item.title: Staged Video From Dhaka Falsely Shared As Hindu Man Assaulting Muslim Boy Selling Balloons In Kolkata
item.description: The video is scripted and from Dhaka, Bangladesh. Both individuals in the video, which was also misleadingly clipped, are Muslims.

item.title: Yogi Adityanath Joins Protests Against New UCG Rules? No, Old Video Shared With False Claim
item.description: The viral video does not show Yogi Adityanath and Ravi Kishan protesting against UGC rules. It is old footage from a September 2025 GST awareness campaign in Gorakhpur.

item.title: Ajit Pawar Death: Photo Of Pilot Killed In June 2025 Air India Tragedy Linked To Baramati Plane Crash
item.description: The viral image does not show the pilot from the recent aircraft crash in Baramati, but actually shows Clive Kunder, who died in the 2025 Air India AI171 crash.

item.title: AI-Generated Video Falsely Shows Indian Army Motorcycle Stunts Failing at Republic Day 2026 Parade
item.description: The viral video does not show a real incident from the Republic Day 2026 parade. It is AI-generated content being shared as if it were genuine footage.
